_doc: CDR routing recall cases (adlc-workspace#36). Each task is phrased the way a user asks, never with the rule's own name. expect = modules a correct routing MUST pick (scored for recall); allow = related modules that are fine to pick (never counted as false positives). Personas and constitution are always allowed. Cases tagged kanfil-* are the generic-name records from the #203 review.

cases.task: Make the names and labels of all Kubernetes resources in our payments chart consistent.
Design the repository layer for the orders data in our Java service.
Our services are hard to unit test because they create their own collaborators. Make them loosely coupled.
The mobile app and the web app need different API responses. Add a separate API layer per client type.
This 1,400-line utils module is unmanageable. Split it into smaller files.
The billing service on Kubernetes needs a database password and a Stripe API key at runtime.
Our GKE pod uploads to a GCS bucket using a JSON key file. Remove the key file.
We need to add a sidecar to the upstream Bitnami Redis chart without forking it.
Roll this service out to dev, staging and prod clusters from Git, automatically synced.
Our pipeline spins up preview environments in AWS for every MR and they keep piling up.
Five repos copy the same build-and-push workflow. Share it from one place on GitHub.
Share common pipeline jobs across our GitLab projects instead of copy-pasting .gitlab-ci.yml.
Set up separate AWS accounts for dev and prod with a central account for CI deploys.
Restructure our Terraform so modules are separate from per-environment config and state.
Let app teams request a Postgres database on any cloud by applying a Kubernetes manifest.
This endpoint builds a WHERE clause by concatenating the search string. Fix it.
We render user comments as HTML in the React app. Make that safe.
Add login with refresh tokens and role-based permissions to the web app and its API.
The dashboard must be available in Hebrew and German.
Build the signup form with field validation and inline error messages.
The checkout page breaks on phones. Make it work on small screens.
The marketing site is slow and doesn't show up well in Google.
When a request fails we can't tell whether the UI or the backend broke. Add tracing and error reporting.
Developers see real customer emails in the dev warehouse. Hide them outside production.
Add tests for the revenue model in our dbt project with fake input rows.
Run our dbt commands as a step of an Airflow pipeline on Kubernetes.
Start the Salesforce sync from our orchestration code and wait until it finishes.
We keep getting NullPointerExceptions from methods that may not find a customer.
Write tests for the invoice parser in our Python service.
Fix the typo 'recieve' in README.md.
